remarks: **Offer Deadline Tuesday 8/12 at 12pm** Welcome to 23 Richelieu Street, tucked away on a quiet street in sought-after West Norwalk. This charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home blends character with potential, featuring a level backyard perfect for play, pets, or gardening-plus a handy storage shed and a basement that provides additional space for your needs.  Inside, the traditional layout offers three bedrooms, with a versatile flex room ideal as a home office or nursery. The home is move-in ready, with plenty of opportunity to update over time and truly make it your own.  Whether you're entering the Fairfield County market for the first time or seeking an investment with strong rental upside, this home delivers on value, location, and long-term potential.  Please note: This is an estate sale, home is being sold as-is
